user.title: Connect Tactacam Reveal
user.description: Sign in with the account used by the Reveal web portal.

error.invalid_auth: Reveal rejected the email or password

abort.already_configured: This Reveal account is already configured

data.persistent_notifications: Create a Home Assistant notification for every new photo

data_description.false_positive_retention_days: Photos classified as empty (false positives) older than this are deleted daily. 0 keeps them forever.
data_description.download_videos: Reveal only uploads a video when it is requested (in the Reveal app or automatically below). Requested videos are archived next to their photo and classified.
data_description.auto_request_videos: Ask Reveal for the video behind new photos. Turning this on opens a page to choose which animals trigger a request. Each video upload costs camera battery.

classification.title: Classification
classification.description: A local camera-trap classifier server (for example SpeciesNet) is tried first. The AI Task entity is used when the local result is missing or not confident, and the stronger AI Task entity when the first AI answer is unsure. Put an empty photo of each scene in the camera's "Reference photos" folder to help the AI ignore rocks and logs.

data_description.classifier_url: Optional. A local camera-trap classifier (free, runs on your own computer) decides most photos; the AI Task only gets the unclear ones. Leave empty to use only the AI Task: simpler to set up, but every photo and video costs AI tokens. For example http://192.168.1.10:8765.
data_description.classifier_token: Only if the server was started with a token.
data_description.country: ISO code such as US. Improves species accuracy. Defaults to the Home Assistant country.
data_description.admin1_region: Optional, such as CA for California.
data_description.min_score: Local results below this go to the AI fallback, or to 'Needs review' without one.
data_description.ai_task_entity: Must support image attachments. Usually a fast, inexpensive model.
data_description.ai_task_entity_strong: Optional. Asked only when the first AI answer is unsure, so a more capable (and costlier) model is used sparingly.
data_description.ai_instructions: Appended to the AI prompt, such as 'Ignore my brown dog'.
data_description.label_aliases: Comma-separated name=folder pairs that rename species, such as eastern cottontail=rabbit.
data_description.ai_cost_per_call: Used only to estimate cloud cost and the savings from local classification.

notifications.title: Phone notifications
notifications.description: Sightings are sent with their photo to the selected phones. Every classified photo also fires the tactacam_reveal_media_classified event for your own automations; its notify field follows these rules too.

data_description.notify_cooldown_minutes: After a notification, the same animal on the same camera stays quiet this long, so a burst of photos sends one alert. 0 turns it off.
data_description.quiet_labels: Comma-separated labels, such as squirrel, vehicle.
data_description.only_notify_labels: Optional comma-separated allow list, such as human, deer. Empty means everything not in the quiet list.

cameras.title: Per-camera settings
cameras.description: Every camera uses the global settings unless you customize it here. Tick one or more cameras, then choose settings for them; the same settings are applied to each ticked camera.\n\nCurrently customized: {customized}

camera_settings.title: Settings for {camera}
camera_settings.description: Fields left empty use the global values. Saving replaces any earlier custom settings of these cameras.

data_description.use_global: Removes all custom settings below from the ticked cameras.
data_description.only_notify_labels: Comma-separated allow list, such as turtle, human.
data_description.quiet_labels: Comma-separated, replaces the global list for these cameras.
data_description.scene_notes: Describe fixed objects that are not animals, for example 'the grey oval rock in the centre is not a turtle'. Overrides a scene.txt file in the camera's reference folder.

video_requests.title: Automatic video requests
video_requests.description: Reveal handles one video request at a time, so requests wait in a queue and the next one is sent when the previous video arrived (or after an hour).

data.video_request_labels: Animals that trigger a video request

data_description.video_request_labels: Comma-separated labels as used for folders, for example: deer, turkey, coyote, turtle. **Leave blank to automatically request ALL videos**, including empty frames.

error.cannot_reach_classifier: The classifier server did not answer at /health
error.ai_no_attachments: This AI Task entity cannot analyze images

sort_media.name: Sort media
sort_media.description: Move an archived Reveal photo, and its video, into a category subfolder within its camera folder.

media_content_id.name: Media content ID
media_content_id.description: Media source ID of the archived photo.

category.name: Category
category.description: Subjects such as 'dog-human'. Labels are lowercased and sorted; empty means falsepositives.

classify_media.name: Classify media
classify_media.description: Classify an archived Reveal photo with the configured local classifier and AI fallback, and optionally sort it.

media_content_id.name: Media content ID
media_content_id.description: Media source ID of the archived photo.

sort.name: Sort
sort.description: Move the photo into its category folder.

fire_event.name: Fire event
fire_event.description: Fire tactacam_reveal_media_classified, which can trigger notifications.

classify_archive.name: Classify archive
classify_archive.description: Classify and sort archived photos in the background. Progress appears on the Photo processing sensor and a notification summarizes the result.

camera.name: Camera
camera.description: Only this camera, such as Back Field. Leave empty for all cameras.

since.name: Since
since.description: Only photos taken on or after this date.

until.name: Until
until.description: Only photos taken on or before this date.

include_sorted.name: Include sorted photos
include_sorted.description: Also re-classify photos already in a category folder.

relabel.name: Relabel media
relabel.description: Move an archived photo (and its video) to a different category folder, for example to correct a classification.

media_content_id.name: Media content ID
media_content_id.description: Media source ID of the archived photo.

category.name: Category
category.description: Such as deer or dog-human. Empty means false positives.

set_reference.name: Set as reference photo
set_reference.description: Use an archived empty photo as its camera's reference scene for the AI.

media_content_id.name: Media content ID
media_content_id.description: Media source ID of an empty photo.

classifier_offline.title: Tactacam classifier server is offline
classifier_offline.description: The local classifier at {url} has not answered for over 10 minutes. New photos fall back to the AI Task entity, or wait in Needs review.

ai_fallback_failing.title: Tactacam AI fallback is failing
ai_fallback_failing.description: The last AI classification failed: {error}. Check the AI provider's credit and the AI Task entity.
